ideas.title: Following the Money in Government Corruption
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trails of government corruption, including the Virginia corruption probe and Minnesota Medicaid fraud.
questions: What are the financial implications of government corruption?
How can we increase transparency and accountability in government?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can uncover patterns of corruption and identify areas for reform. This story has the potential to expose widespread corruption and spark meaningful change.
